description: PokeMMO (Java multiplayer Pokemon client; ROMs preconfigured)
long: PokeMMO is a fan-made massively multiplayer online client that turns classic Pokemon games into a shared online world. Players explore familiar regions together, trade, and battle other trainers in real time. It features competitive online PvP, a player-driven economy, and seasonal events.
